abilities.critical_failure: The creature takes 6d12+40 mental damage. If the creatures’ next d20 roll is a critical success, they earn a critical failure instead. This is a misfortune effect.
abilities.critical_success: The creature is unaffected and is immune to this effect for 10 minutes.
abilities.effect: Arcs of divine energy travel between the two circles. Each creature within the circles takes 4d10+26 spirit damage (DC 45 basic Fortitude save). If one of the ritual circles has been disabled, the hazard instead affects all creature in the room, but each creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their save. The hazard rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Reorder Reality
abilities.trigger: A creature other than Seldeg enters the area contained by the ritual circles

hazard.description: Seldeg’s ritual nears its conclusion, causing magical energy to arc erratically between the ritual circles.
hazard.disable: DC 44 Arazni Lore or Iomedae Lore to recount a tale from history that grounds that deity in the current reality, DC 50 Crafting (legendary) to create a device to siphon energy from the ritual circle, or DC 46 Religion (legendary) to discharge the escalating divine energy; six successes (three successes per circle) are required to disarm the hazard
hazard.name: Twist of Fate
hazard.reset: While atop the floating platform, Seldeg Bhedlis can use a 3-action activity with the auditory trait to reenergize the ritual. Doing so removes one success to disable the hazard and immediately triggers the hazard’s Reorder Reality reaction.
hazard.routine: (1 action; divine) The divine energy gathered by the ritual spikes. One of the eleven stained-glass windows (each depicting one of her Eleven Acts) transforms to feature Arazni instead. Any creature that can see the window change must attempt a DC 50 Will save.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.note: to notice the buildup of divine energy and anticipate its discharge.

hazard.text: If all 11 windows transform, Seldeg’s ritual finishes ahead of schedule. The stained-glass windows shatter, dealing 8d10+52 piercing damage (DC 50 Reflex save) to each creature in the room. The hazard then becomes inactive.

traits.name: Unique
traits.text: A rules element with this trait is one-of-a-kind. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to creatures with this trait is increased by 10.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Divine
traits.text:
This magic comes from the divine tradition, drawing power from deities or similar sources. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to divine magic.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.
